target_name: Organic Intangible Tilt on Short-Dated Debt
rationale: This is a mechanical MIN-splice of two legs that already exist verbatim in the archive (the gen-2 organic-minus-acquired numerator and the gen-4 NEG(dlc/at) gate), so it is a cosmetic leg swap rather than a new economic mechanism, and the coverage gain it advertises comes only from dropping the cash-floor requirement that was arguably doing the work.

Redefining the floor as a genuine coverage ratio (cash flow against claims due) rather than an asset-scaled level is a defensible, economically distinct change to the most-repeated archive component, though the denominator ADD(dlc, lct) double-counts short-term debt since dlc is already inside current liabilities, and the intangible-light leg is still lifted unchanged from gen-3.

target_name: Purchased Intangibles in Excess of Liquid Resources
rationale: The construct (operating intangible assets minus net working capital, scaled by assets) is a partial re-derivation of net operating assets, a well-known published anomaly, and internally the two components pull against each other — NOA evidence says high working capital predicts *low* returns, whereas here subtracting it pushes the score toward the predicted-high-return end, so a flat slope is a plausible mechanical outcome rather than a diagnostic one.

target_name: Research Backed by Cash Unit Economics
rationale: The critique of ib/revt being mechanically depressed by expensed R&D is correct and the pre-R&D, post-depreciation margin is the right accounting fix, though the design is still the archive's standard "R&D intensity MIN gate" template and the margin leg is close to Novy-Marx gross profitability, so the incremental content is the accounting correction rather than a new channel.

target_name: Lifetime Research Payback in Retained Earnings
rationale: Within the R&D-intensity gate the ranking variable re/TS_SUM(xrd,5) is close to an inverse-R&D-intensity-times-retained-earnings composite, so it largely re-ranks the very characteristic the gate conditions on and overlaps the archived gen-0 Retained-Earnings-Financed Research Gate with only the denominator changed from assets to research spend.

target_name: Downside-Adjusted Cash Generation Behind Intangible-Light Firms
rationale: TS_MIN of a cash-flow series already impounds most of that series' volatility, so subtracting VOL from the floor is near-redundant arithmetic on two archived parents sharing an identical intangibles leg — the definition of a cosmetic variant, and the stated fallback ("we learn the floor already impounds stability") is an outcome that can be anticipated without the test.
